title: Residential lease, Cairo
notice: All people, IDs and numbers are fictional.
text:
RESIDENTIAL LEASE AGREEMENT
Cairo, Arab Republic of Egypt

This Residential Lease Agreement ("the Lease") is made on 15 August 2024 between the parties named in Clause 1.

--- Page 1 ---
1. Parties. Karim Fathy, national ID 27506120104839, of 3 Road 9, Maadi, Cairo ("the Landlord"), and Mona Adel, national ID 29503140101234, phone +20 100 555 0192, email mona.adel@example.com ("the Tenant").

2. Premises and term. The Landlord leases to the Tenant the apartment at 14 El-Nadi St, Flat 7, Maadi, Cairo ("the Premises") for a term of three (3) years starting 1 September 2024.

--- Page 2 ---
3. Use. The Tenant will use the Premises as a private residence only and will not sublet any part of it without the Landlord's written consent.

4. Utilities. The Tenant pays for electricity, water and gas as metered. Building service charges are included in the rent.

5. Maintenance. The Landlord is responsible for structural repairs, plumbing and the building's common areas. The Tenant keeps the Premises clean and repairs damage caused by the Tenant or the Tenant's guests.

--- Page 3 ---
6. Deposit. The Tenant pays a security deposit of EGP 17,000 on signing. The Landlord returns the deposit within 30 days after the Lease ends, less any unpaid rent or the cost of repairing damage beyond normal wear. If the Tenant leaves before the end of the term without the notice required by Clause 10, the Landlord may keep one month's rent from the deposit.

7. Rent. The monthly rent is EGP 8,500. The Landlord may increase the rent once per contract year by no more than 10%, with at least 60 days' written notice to the Tenant.

--- Page 4 ---
8. Payment. Rent is due on the first day of each month by bank transfer to the Landlord's account EG38 0019 0005 0000 0000 2631 8000 2. Rent paid more than 10 days late carries a fee of EGP 250.

9. Entry. The Landlord may enter the Premises for inspection or repairs with at least 24 hours' notice to the Tenant, except in an emergency.

--- Page 5 ---
10. Termination. Either party may end the Lease at the end of a contract year with at least 60 days' written notice. The Tenant may end the Lease early with 90 days' written notice, subject to Clause 6.

11. Notices. Notices must be in writing and delivered to the addresses in Clauses 1 and 2, or sent by email to the Tenant at mona.adel@example.com.

--- Page 6 ---
12. Governing law and signatures. This Lease is governed by the laws of Egypt. Signed on 15 August 2024 by Karim Fathy (Landlord) and Mona Adel (Tenant), witnessed by Sara Nabil, phone 0122 555 0148.

EMPLOYMENT OFFER AND AGREEMENT
Giza, Arab Republic of Egypt

This Employment Agreement is signed on 1 November 2025.

1. Parties. Between Ramy Lotfy, for Nile Ledger Systems ("Employer"), and Salma Mostafa, national ID 29605210104321, phone +20 101 333 8899, email salma.mostafa@example.com, residing at 22 Syria St, Mohandessin, Giza ("Employee").

2. Compensation. The Employee's gross monthly salary is EGP 65,000, paid on the 25th of each month.

3. Direct Deposit. Salary will be transferred to the Employee's IBAN EG38 0019 0005 0000 0000 2631 8000 2.

4. Probation. The first ninety (90) days of employment are a probationary period during which either party may end the contract with seven (7) days' written notice.

5. Annual Leave. The Employee receives twenty-one (21) working days of paid annual leave.

6. Annual Performance Bonus. At 100% target achievement, the Employee earns an annual bonus equal to 1.8 times the gross monthly salary.

7. Equipment Allowance. The Employer provides a one-time home-office equipment allowance of up to EGP 3,000 on submission of original receipts. Any amount above EGP 3,000 is paid by the Employee.

8. Intellectual Property. Inventions made with Company equipment or relating to the Company's business belong to the Company. Works created entirely on the Employee's own time, without Company equipment or confidential data, and unrelated to the Company's products remain the Employee's property.

9. Non-Competition. For six (6) months after termination, the Employee may not work for a direct competitor offering consumer payment gateway or mobile wallet services in Egypt. This does not apply to non-financial software such as healthcare, education or logistics.

10. Termination Without Cause. If the Employer ends this Agreement without cause after the probation period, the Employer shall pay severance equal to two (2) months of gross monthly salary, plus a 60-day notice period.
